key_findings: Melatonin relieves TMJOA chronic pain in rats via MT2R, reducing CGRP+ and IB4+ TG neuron sensitization.
MT levels are higher in synovial fluid of TMJOA patients and rats; MT2R is upregulated in TG neurons.
